result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.get_node_creation_order()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Get nodes in their creation order. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L3224-L3273){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.get_node_creation_order() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Returns node IDs ordered by when they were added to the graph. The first node created appears first, the most recently created node appears last. Useful for temporal analysis or recreating graph construction history. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [list[int]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Node IDs in chronological creation order. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Track node creation order: ::: {#acfec170 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph() graph.add_node(label="A") graph.add_node(label="B") graph.add_node(label="C") creation_order = graph.get_node_creation_order() # Returns [, , ] creation_order ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` [1, 2, 3] ``` ::: ::: ::: {#dbc1c5e6 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Get labels in creation order labels = [graph.get_node(nid).label for nid in creation_order] # Returns ['A', 'B', 'C'] labels ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` ['A', 'B', 'C'] ``` ::: ::: Select recently created nodes: ::: {#2d98fe89 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ec.Graph().add_path_graph(10) # Select the last 5 nodes created recent = graph.get_node_creation_order()[-5:] graph.select_nodes_by_id(recent) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` Number of nodes : 10 Number of edges : 9 Directed : False Density : 0.20 Average degree (min, max) : 1.80 (1, 2) Connected : True Number of connected components : 1 Tree : True Bipartite : True ``` ::: :::
